title: Trinity Audit Event (RecordProxy v1)
description: Authoritative shape for a single row in the per-session SQLite audit_events table written by AuditWriter (RecordProxy v1). 13 fields total (11 required + 2 optional). Mirrors recordproxy/schemas.py + capture_store.py SQLite DDL @ commit 4a6fd80. See docs/specs/TRINITY_AUDIT_EVENT_SPEC_V1.md §2 for prose. The legacy .ai/audit/events.ndjson 5-field shape is preserved separately in .ai/schemas/events.schema.json (Audit Spec §2.2 legacy/export compatibility).

schema_version.description: Schema version constant per recordproxy/schemas.py AUDIT_EVENT_SCHEMA_VERSION. DESIGN.md §16 invariant: 'No schema_version = invalid system artifact.' Future versions require Article XXIX Addendum.

event_id.description: Per-event UUID4 hex; matches AuditWriter._event_id() pattern at audit_writer.py:21-22.

seq.description: Session-scoped monotonic sequence. Claimed by AuditWriter under BEGIN IMMEDIATE per audit_writer.py:57-69. UNIQUE(session_id, seq) per capture_store.py:70.

event_type.description: Canonical event-type name from TRINITY_AUDIT_EVENT_SPEC_V1 §3 registry (kernel + RecordProxy unified namespace). Legacy aliases per §3.1 accepted by readers.

ritual.description: Originating ritual when applicable: sss/vvv/nnn/gogogo/ddd/rrr/close. Null for cross-ritual events (e.g. graph.transition, llm.*).

capture_id.description: ULID linking to a captures.capture_id row when the event was produced inside a capture transaction. Null when the event has no enclosing capture (e.g. session.created, sandbox.profile.bound).

actor.description: Who produced the event: kernel / agent:<name> / tool:<name> / human.

ts_utc.description: RFC3339 UTC timestamp. AuditWriter writes ISO Z form per capture_store.py:86-87.

payload_json.description: Canonicalised JSON body (sort_keys=True, separators=(',',':')). String type because the SQLite column is TEXT (capture_store.py:66) — the canonical form is the storage form, not a re-encoded object.

payload_hash.description: SHA-256 hex of payload_json bytes (UTF-8). Per audit_writer.py:25-26.

prev_hash.description: Previous event's hash. Genesis = '0' per audit_writer.py:18 GENESIS_PREV_HASH.

hash.description: SHA-256 hex of canonical_json(event_for_hash). event_for_hash includes {event_id, schema_version, session_id, seq, event_type, ritual, capture_id, actor, ts_utc, payload_hash, prev_hash} — does NOT include payload_json itself (payload_hash represents it). Per audit_writer.py:71-86 and TRINITY_AUDIT_EVENT_SPEC_V1 §2.1.
